name: Frag Grenade
description: 3 damage to all units within 1.5 tiles of the impact tile. Throw range 10, needs LOS. Destroys destructible cover and removes 1 armor.

name: Medkit
description: Heal 4 HP, or stabilize a bleeding-out soldier. Target must be adjacent (or self).

name: Smoke Grenade
description: +20 defense to units in radius 1.5 for 2 turns.

name: Arc Stunner
description: Melee, 70% base hit. A Proxy at 60% HP or less becomes Stunned (capturable). A robot takes 2 damage and is stunned for 1 turn.

name: Lace Jammer
description: Grenade: stuns Husks in radius 2 for 1 turn.

name: Breach Charge
description: 5 damage, radius 1. Can destroy walls (# becomes rubble).
